$comment: REFERENCE parameters for TC-010 runs after the platform fixes RK-08..RK-10 (made after the official runs had been seen). Identical to TC-010.json except W1 uses the per-request delay mode. Results under these parameters are reference only (plan §2.4: the official result is the run under TC-010.json).

batches_per_window.A: immediately after the fault is applied (proxy log or façade ack)
batches_per_window.B: 1500 ms after batch A was dispatched
batches_per_window.concurrency: each batch = repetitions_per_request sequential rounds; one round sends every operation concurrently (12 requests)

tiers_not_implemented.privileged/P: no entry point in the PoC ledger
tiers_not_implemented.break-glass/P: separate path outside the platform (ADR-029 D29-81), not built in line 1
tiers_not_implemented.break-glass/B: no typed break-glass exception in the PoC

operations.subject: external guest whose folder carries restricted_external

windows_openfga.fault: inj-pep delay_each 5000 ms (every request delayed, > D(t) = 3000 ms)
inj-engine delay 5000 ms (> façade engine timeout 1500 ms)
inj-engine status 400 (condition / CEL evaluation error as returned by OpenFGA)

windows_cedar.note: evaluation without schema may still produce valid decisions; recorded, counted only if an expected-deny request is allowed

definitions.write_plus_allow: tier in {write, privileged} and allowed, in a fault window of class U or I (any subject), or of class F where the subject's expected_normal is deny, or of class F after the first fm13 alarm of that window (any subject). Allows of expected-allow subjects in class F before the alarm are reported separately (pre_detection_correct_allows).
definitions.indeterminate_to_allow: class I window, tier != public, allowed (any subject)
definitions.rs_allow_in_outage: class U or I window, tier read-sensitive, allowed (provisional rule: rs reads as deny until KD08-1)
definitions.empty_list_in_outage: class U, I or F window, list operation answered 2xx with an empty item list
definitions.bypass: a netstat sample during a fault window showing a client connection to the OpenFGA HTTP port owned by a process other than inj-engine (the façade's only configured path) and other than the test harness process itself (its keep-alive readiness probe of OpenFGA after a process start is not part of the system under test)
definitions.alarm_all_allow: each window with allow_widening=true has at least one fm13_wrong_answer alarm with allow_widening=true
definitions.reason_code_split: class U decisions recorded by the façade carry deny_unavailable (or no façade record when the façade is unreachable) and class I decisions carry deny_indeterminate (recorded, hypothesis part, not a numbered pass criterion)
definitions.matrix_conformance: public allowed in every window; rs/w/pT denied with 503 in class U and I windows and in class F after detection (fail-mode-matrix §6.1, §6.2, §6.13 with the provisional rs rule)

abort.C-3: baseline window: any expected-allow request denied or any expected-deny request allowed; or the system does not recover (owner read 200) within recovery_timeout_ms after a fault is cleared. Upper limit of control failures = 0
abort.C-5: during a fault window a non-target component fails its health probe (state-store /healthz, STS /jwks, AS discovery; plus the façade /healthz for engine-side faults) or the public operation fails
